snippet.title: Inda Karane: Turnabout Tsundere - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Inda Karane: Turnabout Tsundere, the 100 girlfriends fangame, is finally here!

A fun distraction turned serious personal journey,  Karane learns what it means to seek the truth, as she has to confront some bleak truths along her path. Does she have what it takes to figure every truth out? And is it worth it to expose them all?

#aceattorney  #fangame #hyakkano 

The game is available for download on both itch.io and Gamejolt:

Gamejolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/IndaKarane-TurnaboutTsundere/929505
Itch.io: https://shizukastudios.itch.io/turnabout-tsundere

Mobile Ports available on separate pages on both itch.io and Gamejolt:

Gamejolt (Mobile port): https://gamejolt.com/games/TurnaboutTsunderemobile/1038324
Itch.io (Mobile port): https://shizukastudios.itch.io/turnabouttsunderemobile
